result.title: KnowMe Paper Radar: Lightweight Discovery of Promising Papers in the Age of Autoresearch
result.comment: Ongoing work. 67 pages with 34 figures and 37 tables. Project website: https://hackerchenzhuo.github.io/knowme-research-ai/en/ GitHub: https://github.com/hackerchenzhuo/knowme-research-ai
result.summary: The growing volume of topically similar papers makes it difficult to identify new work that can offer useful research insights or methodological guidance. We present KnowMe Paper Radar, a lightweight discovery tool that combines multiple sources of evidence into personalized reading priorities. Users specify topics, priorities, exclusions and dates; the system brings together topical relevance, recency, author research histories, collaboration paths and direction-specific institutional context. By exposing each score component and its supporting sources, KnowMe helps readers select promising papers for their current questions and discover relevant work beyond familiar authors. Automatic acquisition, version merging and graph-cache reuse keep this workflow convenient without large language model (LLM) inference during ordinary use. Experiments on 174,640 acquired records show more than threefold faster repeated context preparation, while cached abstracts improve normalized discounted cumulative gain at rank 10 (NDCG@10) from 0.412 to 0.598 on expert-judged retrieval tasks. Complementary analyses examine how the same accumulated records support semantic retrieval, research-history modeling and literature-grounded planning. A browser interface and a structured command-line interface (CLI) make these capabilities available to both researchers and research agents, positioning KnowMe as a practical upstream tool for literature-informed recursive self-improvement (RSI) workflows.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 KnowMe Paper Radar，一个文献发现工具，融合主题相关性、时效性、作者历史与机构信息等证据为读者生成个性化阅读优先级，并配以缓存与版本合并以加速重复检索。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是面向文献筛选与排序的检索工具，不涉及 VLM 推理状态、视觉证据使用或 latent 生成与训练，其打分与缓存机制也与推理期计算、停止决策或表示几何无具体可迁移线索，故排除。
